steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your formal application to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Our training team provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll sit for the computer-based exam at a proctored testing center on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you earn the PMP® credential valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) across the renewal cycle through continuing education, volunteer work, or industry contributions. PMI provides clear pathways to keep your certification current and competitive.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
